title: TAPPaaS Module Console File
description: Schema for console.json, which a module may ship beside its module JSON: the sections it adds to its page in the console, and the operations it offers there. A section reads a manager or controller verb with --json and names how to draw the answer. The console reads the file with each page and shows a bad section as an error in its place.

$schema.description: Relative path back to this file, for editor completion.

sections.description: The module's sections. An id the page already has replaces that section in its place; a new id is added before Operate. before and after move either.

operations.description: Verbs that carry a manifest, shown through the operate dialog (Change, Preview, Apply). A verb no manifest declares is shown as an error.

path.description: A JSON path in the verb's answer, dotted: node.memory, disks.0.size.

format.description: How a value reads: bytes and mib as a size, percent with its sign, module as a link to that module's page, status as a coloured word.

bin.description: The manager or controller. A verb its manifest does not declare as a read is refused.

args.description: Its arguments; $module stands for the module's name.

labelPath.description: A gauge per row: the path of its name.

value.description: gauges: the path of how much is used.

max.description: gauges: the path of the whole.

rows.description: Where the rows are in the answer. Without it the answer itself: an array for a table, an object for kv.

fields.description: gauges: each gauge. kv: each row; without it, the answer's plain values.

before.description: Move this section before that one.

after.description: Move this section after that one.

else.description: No render: this entry only moves a section the page already has.

args.description: The positionals the page fixes; $module stands for the module's name.
